title: storage/pkg/lockfile: unit tests unreasonably slow
body:
```
$ go test -v ./storage/pkg/lockfile/
=== RUN   TestLockfileName
--- PASS: TestLockfileName (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestTryWriteLockFile
--- PASS: TestTryWriteLockFile (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestTryReadLockFile
--- PASS: TestTryReadLockFile (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestTryLockState
--- PASS: TestTryLockState (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileRead
--- PASS: TestLockfileRead (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestROLockfileRead
--- PASS: TestROLockfileRead (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileWrite
--- PASS: TestLockfileWrite (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestROLockfileWrite
--- PASS: TestROLockfileWrite (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileTouch
--- PASS: TestLockfileTouch (2.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileRecordWrite
--- PASS: TestLockfileRecordWrite (2.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileWriteConcurrent
--- PASS: TestLockfileWriteConcurrent (0.03s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileReadConcurrent
--- PASS: TestLockfileReadConcurrent (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileMixedConcurrent
--- PASS: TestLockfileMixedConcurrent (51.24s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileMultiprocessRead
    lockfile_test.go:575:       child    8 acquired the read lock
  ...
    lockfile_test.go:586:       telling child   28 to release the read lock
--- PASS: TestLockfileMultiprocessRead (1.05s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileMultiprocessWrite
    lockfile_test.go:619:       child    1 acquired the write lock
  ...
    lockfile_test.go:630:       telling child   10 to release the write lock
--- PASS: TestLockfileMultiprocessWrite (10.01s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileMultiprocessMixed
    lockfile_test.go:683:       child    1 acquired the write lock
 ...
    lockfile_test.go:711:       telling child  141 to release the write lock
--- PASS: TestLockfileMultiprocessMixed (16.07s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileMultiprocessModified
--- PASS: TestLockfileMultiprocessModified (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestLockfileMultiprocessModifiedSince
--- PASS: TestLockfileMultiprocessModifiedSince (0.01s)
```

I have not looked in detail but these times times seems unreasonable slow and thus wasting CI time.
In CI logs I see this package taking over 2 minutes to test.

comments.body:
Yes… they are actually trying to trigger races.

That’s not to say there is nothing to fix, e.g. `TestLockfileMixedConcurrent` contains 100ms-long sleeps.

Another alternative (potentially risky in another way) would be to cache the Go test cache across CI runs.

> Another alternative (potentially risky in another way) would be to cache the Go test cache across CI runs.

Yeah given the amount of cache related bugs I have seen since we started using github actions adding more caches the lost thing on my list atm.
